clauses.clause: Soul Sear deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
clauses.evidence: 'target slot (cast): 1..1 of [you_bear, you_giant, opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant]' (every creature, no player, no artifact/enchantment); each [cast targets=[X]]: 'X is dealt 5 damage (by card/DEAL_DAMAGE)' and X dies; the instant goes to the graveyard, cost R-1 plus 2 generic. Tree equals the compiler's parse (B5b-named-damage). Planeswalker target (none on the probe board): pack soul_sear_planeswalker, Basri Ket at loyalty 7 is left at 2: PASS.
clauses.issue: engine-limit: no priority; the instant is cast only in its controller's own action window (weaker only).

clauses.clause: That permanent loses indestructible until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: No indestructible permanent on the probe board. Tree: LOSE_ABILITY INDESTRUCTIBLE, DurationEot, on referent 'target' (equals B5b-loses-kw-eot). Packs: soul_sear_indestructible_dies (a 4/4 indestructible dies to it) PASS; soul_sear_loses_indestructible_rest_of_turn (a 6/8 indestructible survives the 5, then dies to 3 more damage the same turn) PASS; soul_sear_indestructible_returns_after_turn (after the turn ends it is indestructible again and survives 9 damage) PASS. The packs kill a mutant without the lose step and a permanent-duration mutant.
